decision.reason: Record the prestress-loss / camber inputs that the dashboard's Hog Calculator uses for BR13A and that the description does not hold (environment, relaxation data, stage times, loads on the girder, method switches), as Assumed placeholders in the new field design.prestress_losses, so the ported losses analysis (pdf2bim/design/prestress.py) can run from the description. Geometry, section, strands, bars, concrete and ages are NOT duplicated: they come from the description / P1 / P2. Standards values (Table 3.1.2, Table 3.3.1, basic drying shrinkage, transmission length) are standards entries, not project data. Every value is a placeholder to replace.
